currentState: The girl trusts Neral and nobody else. Neral guards her, carries her, feeds her, takes her account, and rides north with her.
powerDynamic: Neral controls the pace and the physical world; the girl controls what she is willing to say and to whom (she speaks only into Neral's shoulder).

physicalDynamics.pattern: Neral lies flat at the hatch and talks through the cracks; spills water to the crack; lifts the lid by degrees; sits on the bottom rung; takes the skin away and gives it back; carries her up the ladder one-handed; sits on the box bed with her in her lap; works a blanket over her bare foot and keeps her hand on it; rocks her; sleeps on the settle with the girl on her chest; kneels on her heels out of the bay's way, hands on her knees; lifts her onto the saddle and mounts behind her, drawing her against her chest and putting her hands in the mane.

nameUsage.neralCallsGirl: No name; asked once, the girl shook her head and Neral let it go.

history.event: Neral talks the girl out of the cellar; the girl gives her account in fragments to Neral.
Neral introduces her to the bay and carries her north with the dispatch.

trajectory: Neral and the girl ride to the Pass together; the girl does not return south.
